Total revenue for August 2026 was **₹11.89 Cr (₹118,935,989.67)** across all channels. Protein Powder brought in almost two-thirds of it.

| Category | Revenue (INR) | Share | Units sold | Sales lines |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Protein Powder | 75,714,609.64 | 63.7% | 33,649 | 17,206 |
| Breakfast | 15,391,067.92 | 12.9% | 45,070 | 22,905 |
| Beverages | 15,237,197.97 | 12.8% | 46,112 | 23,376 |
| Snacking | 10,388,930.75 | 8.7% | 44,986 | 23,382 |
| Protein Bars | 2,204,183.39 | 1.9% | 33,320 | 16,937 |
| **Total** | **118,935,989.67** | 100% | 203,137 | 103,806 |

- **Protein Powder has the highest value per unit.** It sold the second-fewest units but averaged about ₹2,250 per unit.
- **Protein Bars sold about as many units as Protein Powder** but averaged about ₹66 per unit, so it brought in less than 2% of revenue.
- Breakfast, Beverages and Snacking each sold about 45k units.

**How it was calculated:**
- **Source:** the `sales.revenue_inr` measure, joined to `item_master.category`, for orders dated 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31.
- **Channels:** all six are included (D2C, Platform, Quick commerce, Offline, International and Cafe).
- **Revenue definition:** the company's standard one. All order statuses are included and soft-deleted rows are excluded. International sales are converted at a fixed 83 INR per USD.

**Check:** I ran a separate SQL query to confirm no revenue was lost or counted twice when matching sales to product categories. All 103,806 sales lines in August matched a catalog entry, each product appears in the catalog only once, and the category totals add up exactly to the overall total.

This uses the standard revenue figure. If you want net-after-fees or gross revenue instead, or a split by channel, I can run that.
